messages:
Noelle (CS): Renewal flag for MeridianAI popped up. They reported higher cost on inference flows and some slower summaries over last 2 weeks. AE worried. Proactive suggestion: compact-int8 pilot + route long docs to standard model + prefix cache. Thoughts?
Ravi (SE): Do we have their token distribution? also what's their SLO for p99?
Ellen (RE): Sample shows heavy long-docs: median 700 tokens, 18% > 2000. int8 looks promising for <1200 sequences. We'll need fidelity checks.
Victor (AE): Customer will accept pilot if we provide clear rollback. Need to show cost numbers and an easy toggle.
Noelle (CS): Let's aim for a 7-day pilot with 80/15/5 split (compact/intake/dedicated). Requesting artifacts: 1) staging perf delta 2) fidelity eval on 5k prompts 3) customer note template.
Ravi (SE): I'll push staging split route. snippet: 
```
route {
  match: "/v1/process"
  condition: "seq_len <= 1200"
  split: "80/15"
  models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
  fallback: "dedicated-highmem"
}
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
batching: { max_batch_ms: 40 }
```
DeployBot: [deploy] staging-route created by ravi at 2025-10-08T10:22Z (id: dpl_4829987675)
Ellen (RE): Running fidelity evals now. Will include BLEU, embedding drift, and hallucination heuristics. Also will compare prefix_kv on/off.
Victor (AE): Confirming I'll loop in renewal stakeholders. Noelle, please include pilot sign-off checklist.
Noelle (CS): Added rollback criteria: >1.5x p99 or >3% fidelity regression on golden set.
Ravi (SE): Perf snapshot will follow. Initial estimate: cost down ~20% for pilot cohort, latency slightly lower.
Ellen (RE): Uploaded preliminary evals to /shared/meridian-pilot. Early find: 2% of samples show minor hallucination increase, investigating specific prompt patterns.
Noelle (CS): Good catch. Keep me posted. Victor, can you prep negotiation levers if pilot uncovers issues?
Victor (AE): Yep will have concession options ready.
Noelle (CS): Action items: Ravi deploy perf & dashboard (ETA 3h), Ellen eval artifacts (ETA 4h), Victor stakeholder loop (ETA EOD).
